channel.title: Japan AI Monitor
channel.description: AI monitoring of Japan's political, economic and security developments

item.title: As more foreign nationals join Japan’s workforce, diversity policies take on new importance
item.description: In response to changing expectations, Japanese organizations have embraced DEI policies, but hurdles remain toward proper implementation.

item.title: Italy pitches Germany observer status in GCAP fighter jet program
item.description: Rome, London and Tokyo are driving the Global Combat Air Program, which aims to put a sixth-generation fighter jet into service by the mid-2030s.

item.title: Japan firms thrive on AI boom, but uncertainty grows
item.description: Factors like raw material prices amid Middle East turmoil and data center construction have come industry analysts concerned.

item.title: Fuel removal at Fukushima No. 2 reactor proceeding smoothly
item.description: The unit suffered no major damage to the building housing the reactor, but radiation levels around the spent fuel pool remain high.

item.title: Swiss franc, Japanese yen Rise as DeepSeek News Boosts Safe Havens
item.description: The Yen and Swiss Franc were stronger against the dollar as investors sought safe havens after Chinese start-up DeepSeek’s new AI model hit U.S. tech stocks.
